command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$base='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02'; `$test='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03'; `$nodes=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri (`$test+'/nodes') -Method Get; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri (`$base+'/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri (`$test+'/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; `$an=`$a -replace '(?m)^!Last configuration.*\r?\n',''; `$bn=`$b -replace '(?m)^!Last configuration.*\r?\n',''; if(`$an -ne `$bn){Write-Output `$n.node_id}}"
